name: DarkVeil-TS-TW

frames.best_why: The blue wave crest and its soft glow read most clearly against the near-black field.

tagline: Deep blue light creeps in slow folds over a near-black field.
summary: A very dark animated backdrop of deep blue light that slowly folds and drifts like a veil across black, with faint horizontal scanlines and a soft glow.
appearance: An almost black field broken by wide, soft bands of deep blue that curve diagonally like folds in fabric, brightest along a glowing crest. Faint horizontal scanlines texture the lit areas, and the rest fades into darkness.
behaviour: The blue folds drift and breathe very slowly, so the surface seems to shift rather than move. Scanlines and a slight noise texture stay put, and the motion never stops.
search_phrases: subtle black gradient backdrop for a hero
blue glow that drifts like a veil
minimal animated background for a landing page
use_when: You need a dark, low-contrast animated backdrop that lets white text and product visuals stay the focus.
avoid_when: It is so dark and low-contrast that on a poor screen it can read as plain black.
customise: Props shift the hue, add noise, set scanline strength and frequency, and change warp, speed and resolution scale. The colours come from the shader, not from props.
weight_why: A full-screen fragment shader recomputes a large layered function on every frame.

a11y.note: The shader animates forever and ignores reduced-motion, with no pause; it also needs a sized parent to fill.

issues: The animation is barely perceptible between frames, so it can look like a static black image.
It ignores reduced-motion and never stops or pauses.
polish_why: Quiet, well-judged gradient, but so dark and slow it barely registers as animated.
